lemma slideStrat_of_ge {n k : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkn : k < n)

    (h₂ : ∃ p q : Fin (2 * n - k), p ≠ q ∧
      labelAt n k hist p.val = labelAt n k hist q.val) :

name: slide_play_facts
statement:
lemma slide_play_facts {n k : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkn : k < n)
    (W : Wizard n) (_hW : W.Valid)
    (hM : ¬ (play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W (2 * n - k + 1)).won)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ 2 * n - k + 1) :
    (play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W j).won = false ∧
    ((play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W j).hist).length = j ∧
    (∀ i (_hi : i < j), ((play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W j).hist)[i]? =
      some (window n k i, reveal ((play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W i).arr) (window n k i))) ∧
    (∀ j' (_hj' : j' < j),
      ((window n k j').image (play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W j').arr).card = k)

    (j : ℕ) (hj : j < 2 * n - k + 1) :
    (play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W (j + 1)).arr =
      (play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W j).arr ∘
        W.perm (play (slideStrat n k hk hkn) W j).hist (window n k j)

      (∑ t ∈ Ico k es.length, X ^ ((es.take t).sum - (es.take k).sum) * qq es[t]!) =
      qq es.sum

name: sum_image_eq_sort_map_sum

    (!₂[(b + 1 : ℕ), 1] : Plane) ∈ L →

name: main

name: pow_deg
statement:
lemma pow_deg (f : HForm) : ∀ n : ℕ, (f.pow n).deg = n * f.deg
  | 0 => (Nat.zero_mul _).symm
  | n + 1 => by
    show (mul (f.pow n) f).deg = (n + 1) * f.deg
    rw [show (mul (f.pow n) f).deg = (f.pow n).deg + f.deg from rfl, pow_deg f n]
    ring

name: eval_pow
statement:
lemma eval_pow (f : HForm) : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x y : ℤ, (f.pow n).eval x y = (f.eval x y) ^ n
  | 0, _, _ => by simp [pow, eval_const]
  | n + 1, x, y => by
    show (mul (f.pow n) f).eval x y = (f.eval x y) ^ (n + 1)
    rw [eval_mul, eval_pow f n, _root_.pow_succ]

    (¬∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ (a = (k : ℝ) * θ ∨ b = (k : ℝ) * θ ∨ c = (k : ℝ) * θ)) →
    ∃ A B C : ℝ, ∃ m : ℕ, ({a, b, c} : Multiset ℝ) = {A, B, C} ∧ 1 ≤ m ∧
      C < (m : ℝ) * θ ∧ (m : ℝ) * θ < 180 - B

    (L.sum = 180 ∧ ∀ y ∈ L, ∀ k : ℤ, y ≠ (k : ℝ) * θ) ∨

    (if p ∈ vitalRowCells k then 1 else 0) +
        (if p ∈ vitalColCells k then 1 else 0) +
        (if p ∈ vitalSumCells k then 1 else 0) +
        (if p ∈ vitalDiffCells k then 1 else 0) =
      1 + 3 * (if p ∈ centerCells k then 1 else 0)

        colorCount f (vitalSumCells k) c + colorCount f (vitalDiffCells k) c =
      colorCount f Finset.univ c + 3 * colorCount f (centerCells k) c

name: cong_aux
statement:
theorem cong_aux : ∀ (P st : Finset (Fin 6)), P ⊆ Finset.univ.erase 5 → P.card = 2 →
    st.card = 4 →
    ((if P ⊆ st then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
      - ∑ u ∈ Finset.univ.erase 5 \ P, (if ({u, 5} : Finset (Fin 6)) ⊆ st then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
      - ∑ Q ∈ (Finset.univ.erase 5 \ P).powersetCard 2,
          (if Q ⊆ st then (1 : ℤ) else 0)) ≡ 0 [ZMOD 3]

name: pairCount_modEq
statement:
theorem pairCount_modEq {n : ℕ} {s : Fin n → Finset (Fin 6)} {c0 : Fin n}
    (hc0 : s c0 = Finset.univ.erase 5) (h4 : ∀ i : Fin n, i ≠ c0 → (s i).card = 4)
    {P : Finset (Fin 6)} (hP : P ∈ (Finset.univ.erase 5 : Finset (Fin 6)).powersetCard 2) :
    (pairCount s P : ℤ)
      ≡ 1 + ∑ u ∈ Finset.univ.erase 5 \ P, (pairCount s {u, 5} : ℤ)
        + ∑ Q ∈ (Finset.univ.erase 5 \ P).powersetCard 2, (pairCount s Q : ℤ) [ZMOD 3]

    {q : ℚ[X]} {N : ℕ} (hqN : q.natDegree ≤ N)
    (hqval : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ N → q.eval (i : ℚ) = (a i : ℚ)) (m : ℕ) {i : ℕ}

name: clearPoly_eq_of_large
statement:
lemma clearPoly_eq_of_large (a : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hdiv : ∀ n m : ℕ, ((n : ℤ) - (m : ℤ)) ∣ a n - a m)
    {q : ℚ[X]} {N : ℕ} (hqN : q.natDegree ≤ N)
    (hqval : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ N → q.eval (i : ℚ) = (a i : ℚ))
    {C C₁ : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → |(clearPoly q N).eval (m : ℤ)| ≤ (C : ℤ) * (m : ℤ) ^ N)
    (hC₁ : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → |a m| ≤ (C₁ : ℤ) * (m : ℤ) ^ N)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 * N < m)
    (hmB : 2 ^ (N + 1) * N ^ (N * (N + 1)) * (C + denomProd q N * C₁) < m) :
    (clearPoly q N).eval (m : ℤ) = (denomProd q N : ℤ) * a m

name: altCount_eq

    (hne : es ≠ []) {s : ℕ} (hs : s ≤ 1) (x : V) :
    ((es.mapIdx fun i e => if s = i % 2 then mult a b e x else 0).sum) =
      ((vs.drop 1).dropLast.count x) +
        (if vs.head? = some x ∧ s = 0 then 1 else 0) +
        (if vs.getLast? = some x ∧ s = (es.length - 1) % 2 then 1 else 0)

  (f : ℕ → NNReal → ℝ)

  (fd : NNReal → NNReal → ↑sd → ℝ)
  (hfd₁ : ∀ (y₁ y₂ : NNReal) (n : ↑sd), fd y₁ y₂ n = f (↑n) y₂ - f (↑n) y₁)
  (hd₁ : ∀ (n : ↑sd) (a b : NNReal), a < b → 0 < fd a b n)

  (hi₀ : 2 ∈ sd)
  (i : ↑sd)

  (sd : Set ℕ)

    a < b →
      (∀ (n : ↑sd), f (↑n) a < f (↑n + 1) a ∧ f (↑n) b < f (↑n + 1) b)

theorem prod_le_of_le (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hx : ∀ n, 0 < x n)
    (h : ∀ n, x n * x (n + 2) ≤ x (n + 1) ^ 2)
    {a b : ℕ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    x (a - 1) * x (b + 1) ≤ x a * x b

name: x0_mul_xn_le
statement:
theorem x0_mul_xn_le (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hx : ∀ n, 0 < x n)
    (h : ∀ n, x n * x (n + 2) ≤ x (n + 1) ^ 2) :
    ∀ {i n : ℕ}, 2 * i ≤ n → x 0 * x n ≤ x i * x (n - i)

name: pair_ge
statement:
theorem pair_ge (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hx : ∀ n, 0 < x n)
    (h : ∀ n, x n * x (n + 2) ≤ x (n + 1) ^ 2)
    {i n : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ n) :
    2 * Real.sqrt (x 0 * x n) ≤ x i + x (n - i)

name: sum_pair_ge
statement:
theorem sum_pair_ge (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hx : ∀ n, 0 < x n)
    (h : ∀ n, x n * x (n + 2) ≤ x (n + 1) ^ 2)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ((n : ℝ) - 1) * (2 * Real.sqrt (x 0 * x n)) ≤
      2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 1), x (i + 1)

name: sum_decomp
statement:
theorem sum_decomp (x : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 2), x i =
      x 0 + (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, x (i + 1)) + x (m + 1)

name: final_algebra
statement:
theorem final_algebra {N k x0 xn : ℝ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hN1 : 0 < N - 1)
    (hkey : (N ^ 2 - 1) * (x0 * xn) ≤ k * (k + x0 + xn)) :
    (x0 + k) / N * ((k + xn) / N) ≤ (x0 + k + xn) / (N + 1) * (k / (N - 1))

name: key_ineq
statement:
theorem key_ineq (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hx : ∀ n, 0 < x n)
    (h : ∀ n, x n * x (n + 2) ≤ x (n + 1) ^ 2)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) * (x 0 * x n) ≤
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 1), x (i + 1)) *
        ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 1), x (i + 1)) + x 0 + x n)

name: cdist_if
statement:
lemma cdist_if (a b : Fin m) :
    cdist a b = if a.val ≤ b.val then b.val - a.val else b.val + m - a.val

name: shift_cdist

statement:

statement:

    nb c used r = Classical.choose (Finset.exists_min_image (avail c used) (cdist r) h)

name: nb_mem
statement:
lemma nb_mem {used : Finset (Fin m)} {r : Fin m} (h : (avail c used).Nonempty) :

name: nb_min
statement:
lemma nb_min {used : Finset (Fin m)} {r : Fin m} (h : (avail c used).Nonempty)
    {q : Fin m} (hq : q ∈ avail c used) :
    cdist r (nb c used r) ≤ cdist r q

    nb c used r = b

lemma card_avail_insert {b : Fin m} {used : Finset (Fin m)} (hb : b ∈ avail c used) :

name: wraps_cons
statement:
lemma wraps_cons (r : Fin m) (rs : List (Fin m)) (used : Finset (Fin m)) :
    wraps c (r :: rs) used =
      wrap r (nb c used r) + wraps c rs (insert (nb c used r) used)

name: wraps_swap_pair
statement:
lemma wraps_swap_pair {r r' : Fin m} (hr : c r = true) (hr' : c r' = true)
    {used : Finset (Fin m)} (hcard : 2 ≤ (avail c used).card) :
    wrap r (nb c used r) + wrap r' (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') =
      wrap r' (nb c used r') + wrap r (nb c (insert (nb c used r') used) r) ∧
    insert (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') (insert (nb c used r) used) =
      insert (nb c (insert (nb c used r') used) r) (insert (nb c used r') used)

name: wraps_perm
statement:
lemma wraps_perm {l₁ l₂ : List (Fin m)} (h : List.Perm l₁ l₂) :
    (∀ r ∈ l₁, c r = true) → ∀ used : Finset (Fin m),
      l₁.length ≤ (avail c used).card → wraps c l₁ used = wraps c l₂ used

name: value_cons

lemma value_cons (n : ℕ) (c : Multiset ℕ) :

name: value_singleton
statement: lemma value_singleton (n : ℕ) : value {n} = (n : ℚ)⁻¹

name: value_replicate

name: cap_eq'

statement: lemma cap_sub_one_le (k : ℕ) : cap k - 1 ≤ cap (k - 1)

name: count_sum_filter_boxes
statement:
lemma count_sum_filter_boxes (k : ℕ) (c : Multiset ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    Multiset.count n (∑ m ∈ Finset.range k, c.filter (fun p ↦ p = 2 * m + 1 ∨ p = 2 * m + 2))
      = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range k,
        (if (n = 2 * m + 1 ∨ n = 2 * m + 2) then Multiset.count n c else 0)

name: filter_boxes_add_pile
statement:
lemma filter_boxes_add_pile (k : ℕ) (c : Multiset ℕ) (hpos : ∀ n ∈ c, 0 < n) :
    (∑ m ∈ Finset.range k, c.filter (fun p ↦ p = 2 * m + 1 ∨ p = 2 * m + 2))
      + c.filter (fun p ↦ 2 * k + 1 ≤ p) = c

name: value_filter_box_le
statement:
lemma value_filter_box_le (c : Multiset ℕ)
    (heven : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → c.count (2 * m) ≤ 1)
    (hodd : ∀ m, c.count (2 * m + 1) ≤ 2 * m) (m : ℕ) :
    value (c.filter (fun p ↦ p = 2 * m + 1 ∨ p = 2 * m + 2))
      ≤ (2 * m : ℚ) * ((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)⁻¹ + ((2 * m + 2 : ℕ) : ℚ)⁻¹

name: box_capacity_lt_one
statement:
lemma box_capacity_lt_one (m : ℕ) :
    (2 * m : ℚ) * ((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)⁻¹ + ((2 * m + 2 : ℕ) : ℚ)⁻¹ < 1

name: greedy
statement:
lemma greedy (k : ℕ) (pile : Multiset ℕ) :
    (∀ n ∈ pile, 2 * k + 1 ≤ n) → ∀ w : Fin k → ℚ, (∀ m, w m ≤ 1) →
    value pile + ∑ m, w m ≤ cap k →
    ∃ parts : Fin k → Multiset ℕ,
      (∑ m, parts m) = pile ∧ ∀ m, w m + value (parts m) ≤ 1

name: exists_partition_aux
statement:
theorem exists_partition_aux : ∀ (N k : ℕ) (c : Multiset ℕ), c.card = N →
    (∀ n ∈ c, 0 < n) → value c ≤ cap k →
    ∃ gs : Multiset (Multiset ℕ), gs.sum = c ∧ gs.card ≤ k ∧ ∀ g ∈ gs, value g ≤ 1

name: exists_partition
statement:
theorem exists_partition (k : ℕ) (c : Multiset ℕ) (hpos : ∀ n ∈ c, 0 < n)
    (hcap : value c ≤ cap k) :
    ∃ gs : Multiset (Multiset ℕ), gs.sum = c ∧ gs.card ≤ k ∧ ∀ g ∈ gs, value g ≤ 1

statement:
lemma exists_intermediate_transversal_of_card_bounds
    (a b : ℕ)
    (ha : 0 < a)
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (color : Cell (a + b + 1) → Fin 2)
    (c0 : a ^ 2 + a * b - b ≤ Fintype.card {s // color s = 0})
    (c1 : b ^ 2 + a * b - a ≤ Fintype.card {s // color s = 1}) :
    ∃ p : Equiv.Perm (Fin (a + b + 1)),
      colorCount color 0 p = a ∨ colorCount color 0 p = a + 1

name: exists_cells_of_intermediate_transversal
statement:
lemma exists_cells_of_intermediate_transversal
    {a b : ℕ}
    (color : Cell (a + b + 1) → Fin 2)
    (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin (a + b + 1)))
    (hp : colorCount color 0 p = a ∨ colorCount color 0 p = a + 1) :
    ∃ A B : Finset (Cell (a + b + 1)),
      A.card = a ∧ B.card = b ∧
      (∀ x ∈ A, color x = 0) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ B, color y = 1) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ A ∪ B, ∀ y ∈ A ∪ B, x ≠ y → x.fst ≠ y.fst ∧ x.snd ≠ y.snd

      k * ((Finset.range 4).filter fun i => P i = true).card +

name: card_range_modeq

name: sum_weights
statement:

    weight (Moves.vxor v (sp n (false, false, false))) +
    weight (Moves.vxor v (sp n (false, false, true))) +
    weight (Moves.vxor v (sp n (false, true, false))) +
    weight (Moves.vxor v (sp n (false, true, true))) +
    weight (Moves.vxor v (sp n (true, false, false))) +
    weight (Moves.vxor v (sp n (true, false, true))) +
    weight (Moves.vxor v (sp n (true, true, false))) +
    weight (Moves.vxor v (sp n (true, true, true))) = 12 * n

    alicePlay σ (t + 1) =
      if ∑ x ∈ S, weightBase ^ (aliceStreak σ t x) ≤
          ∑ x ∈ Sᶜ, weightBase ^ (aliceStreak σ t x)
      then (fun x => if x ∈ S then aliceStreak σ t x + 1 else 0,

            aliceHist σ t ++ [true], true)

name: card_between
statement:
lemma card_between {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {A C : Finset α} (hAC : A ⊆ C)
    {t : ℕ} (hAt : A.card ≤ t) :
    Nat.card {X : Finset α // A ⊆ X ∧ X ⊆ C ∧ X.card = t} =
      (C.card - A.card).choose (t - A.card)

name: ncard_fillings_insert

lemma ncard_fillings_insert {n : ℕ} {D : Set (Cell n)} {s : Cell n} (hs : s ∉ D)
    {A C : (Cell n → Finset (Fin (2 * n))) → Finset (Fin (2 * n))}
    (hlo : ∀ f ∈ Fillings n D, ∀ d ∈ D, d ≤ s → f d ⊆ A f)
    (hhi : ∀ f ∈ Fillings n D, ∀ d ∈ D, s ≤ d → C f ⊆ f d)
    (hAs : ∀ g ∈ Fillings n (insert s D), A (Function.update g s ∅) ⊆ g s)
    (hsC : ∀ g ∈ Fillings n (insert s D), g s ⊆ C (Function.update g s ∅))
    (hAC : ∀ f ∈ Fillings n D, A f ⊆ C f)
    {a₀ c₀ : ℕ}
    (hAcard : ∀ f ∈ Fillings n D, (A f).card = a₀)
    (hCcard : ∀ f ∈ Fillings n D, (C f).card = c₀)
    (hAt : ∀ f ∈ Fillings n D, (A f).card ≤ target s) :
    (Fillings n (insert s D)).ncard =
      (c₀ - a₀).choose (target s - a₀) * (Fillings n D).ncard

    (hsum : (selectedList p I).sum = (selectedList p J).sum) :
    ∃ c : List ℝ,
      (∀ z ∈ c, 0 < z) ∧
      c.length ≤ I.card + J.card - 1 ∧
      ∃ bI : Fin (selectedList p I).length → List ℝ,

        (∀ i, ∀ z ∈ bI i, 0 < z) ∧

        (∀ j, bJ j ≠ []) ∧

    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ xs, 0 < x) (target : ℝ)
    (htarget : 0 < target) (hle : target ≤ xs.sum) :
    ∃ pre x post, xs = pre ++ x :: post ∧
      pre.sum < target ∧ target ≤ pre.sum + x

name: exists_prefix_match_residual
statement:
theorem exists_prefix_match_residual (xs : List ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ xs, 0 < x) (target : ℝ)
    (htarget : 0 < target) (hle : target ≤ xs.sum) :
    ∃ pre x post t rho,
      xs = pre ++ x :: post ∧
      0 < t ∧ 0 ≤ rho ∧ rho ≤ xs.sum - target ∧
      x = t + rho ∧ (pre ++ [t]).sum = target

name: finBlocks_prefixFlattenBlocks
statement:
lemma finBlocks_prefixFlattenBlocks (pre : List ℝ) (x : ℝ)

    finBlocks (prefixFlattenBlocks pre x post t rho bm) =
      List.ofFn (appendToLast (n := pre.length) bm (residualList rho)) ++

    (hpne : p ≠ []) (hppos : ∀ x ∈ p, 0 < x) (hpsum : p.sum = 1)
    (I J : Finset (Fin p.length)) (hIJ : Disjoint I J)
    (hJsum : 0 < (selectedList p J).sum)
    (hdiff0 : 0 ≤ (selectedList p I).sum - (selectedList p J).sum)
    {delta : ℝ}
    (hdiff : (selectedList p I).sum - (selectedList p J).sum ≤ delta) :
    ∃ l : List ℝ,
      l ≠ [] ∧
      (∀ z ∈ l, 0 < z) ∧
      l.sum = 1 ∧
      cutsOfLengths p ⊆ cutsOfLengths l ∧
      l.length ≤ 2 * p.length - 1 ∧
      firstPlayerShare l ≤ (1 + delta) / 2

statement: private lemma paired_injective (hf : Injective f) : Injective (paired f)

name: erdos_szekeres
statement:
private theorem erdos_szekeres {r s : ℕ} {f : α → β}
    (hn : r * s < Fintype.card α) (hf : Injective f) :
    (∃ t : Finset α, r < #t ∧ StrictMonoOn f t) ∨
      ∃ t : Finset α, s < #t ∧ StrictAntiOn f t

name: mem_rect
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_rect {x_min x_max y_min y_max : ℕ} {p : Point n} :
    p ∈ rect n x_min x_max y_min y_max ↔
    x_min ≤ px p ∧ px p < x_max ∧
    y_min ≤ py p ∧ py p < y_max

name: chain_u_mono_le
statement:
lemma chain_u_mono_le
    (h_u_mono : ∀ a ∈ u, ∀ b ∈ u, px a < px b → py a < py b)
    (h_u_inj : ∀ a ∈ u, ∀ b ∈ u, px a = px b → a = b)
    : ∀ a ∈ u, ∀ b ∈ u, px a ≤ px b → py a ≤ py b

name: chain_v_mono_le
statement:
lemma chain_v_mono_le
    (h_v_mono : ∀ a ∈ v, ∀ b ∈ v, px a < px b → py b < py a)
    (h_v_inj : ∀ a ∈ v, ∀ b ∈ v, px a = px b → a = b)
    : ∀ a ∈ v, ∀ b ∈ v, px a ≤ px b → py b ≤ py a

name: chain_u_inj_y
statement:
lemma chain_u_inj_y
    (h_u_mono : ∀ a ∈ u, ∀ b ∈ u, px a < px b → py a < py b)
    (h_u_inj : ∀ a ∈ u, ∀ b ∈ u, px a = px b → a = b)
    : ∀ a ∈ u, ∀ b ∈ u, py a = py b → a = b

name: chain_v_inj_y
statement:
lemma chain_v_inj_y
    (h_v_mono : ∀ a ∈ v, ∀ b ∈ v, px a < px b → py b < py a)
    (h_v_inj : ∀ a ∈ v, ∀ b ∈ v, px a = px b → a = b)
    : ∀ a ∈ v, ∀ b ∈ v, py a = py b → a = b

name: mem_u_lower
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_u_lower (p : Point n) :
    p ∈ u_lower u ↔ ∃ q ∈ u, px q ≤ px p ∧ py p ≤ py q

name: mem_u_upper
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_u_upper (p : Point n) :
    p ∈ u_upper u ↔ ∃ q ∈ u, px p ≤ px q ∧ py q ≤ py p

name: mem_v_lower
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_v_lower (p : Point n) :
    p ∈ v_lower v ↔ ∃ r ∈ v, px p ≤ px r ∧ py p ≤ py r

name: mem_v_upper
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_v_upper (p : Point n) :
    p ∈ v_upper v ↔ ∃ r ∈ v, px r ≤ px p ∧ py r ≤ py p

name: mem_regionWExtend
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_regionWExtend (p : Point n) :
    p ∈ regionWExtend u v ↔ p ∈ u_lower u ∧ p ∈ v_lower v

name: mem_regionNExtend
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_regionNExtend (p : Point n) :
    p ∈ regionNExtend u v ↔ p ∈ u_upper u ∧ p ∈ v_lower v

name: mem_regionSExtend
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_regionSExtend (p : Point n) :
    p ∈ regionSExtend u v ↔ p ∈ u_lower u ∧ p ∈ v_upper v

name: mem_regionEExtend
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_regionEExtend (p : Point n) :
    p ∈ regionEExtend u v ↔ p ∈ u_upper u ∧ p ∈ v_upper v

name: mem_targetsW
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_targetsW (p : Point n) :
    p ∈ targetsW u v all_black ↔ p ∈ all_black ∧ p ∈ regionWExtend u v

name: mem_targetsN
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_targetsN (p : Point n) :
    p ∈ targetsN u v all_black ↔ p ∈ all_black ∧ p ∈ regionNExtend u v

name: mem_targetsS
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_targetsS (p : Point n) :
    p ∈ targetsS u v all_black ↔ p ∈ all_black ∧ p ∈ regionSExtend u v

name: mem_targetsE
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_targetsE (p : Point n) :
    p ∈ targetsE u v all_black ↔ p ∈ all_black ∧ p ∈ regionEExtend u v

name: mem_targetsWin
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_targetsWin {p : Point n} :
    p ∈ targetsWin u v all_black ↔ p ∈ targetsW u v all_black ∧ 0 < py p

name: mem_targetsNin
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_targetsNin {p : Point n} :
    p ∈ targetsNin u v all_black ↔ p ∈ targetsN u v all_black ∧ 0 < px p

name: mem_targetsSin
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_targetsSin {p : Point n} :
    p ∈ targetsSin u v all_black ↔ p ∈ targetsS u v all_black ∧ px p < n - 1

name: mem_targetsEin
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_targetsEin {p : Point n} :
    p ∈ targetsEin u v all_black ↔ p ∈ targetsE u v all_black ∧ py p < n - 1

name: card_filter_ge_sub_one
statement:
lemma card_filter_ge_sub_one {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (S : Finset α) (P : α → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (h_boundary : (S.filter (fun x => ¬ P x)).card ≤ 1) :
    (S.filter P).card ≥ S.card - 1

name: targetsWin_inequality
statement:
theorem targetsWin_inequality
    (h_unique_y : ∀ p ∈ all_black, ∀ q ∈ all_black, py p = py q → p = q) :
    (targetsWin u v all_black).card ≥ (targetsW u v all_black).card - 1

name: targetsNin_inequality
statement:
theorem targetsNin_inequality
    (h_unique_x : ∀ p ∈ all_black, ∀ q ∈ all_black, px p = px q → p = q) :
    (targetsNin u v all_black).card ≥ (targetsN u v all_black).card - 1

name: targetsSin_inequality
statement:
theorem targetsSin_inequality
    (h_unique_x : ∀ p ∈ all_black, ∀ q ∈ all_black, px p = px q → p = q) :
    (targetsSin u v all_black).card ≥ (targetsS u v all_black).card - 1

name: targetsEin_inequality
statement:
theorem targetsEin_inequality
    (h_unique_y : ∀ p ∈ all_black, ∀ q ∈ all_black, py p = py q → p = q) :
    (targetsEin u v all_black).card ≥ (targetsE u v all_black).card - 1

name: sum_card_eq_sum_incidence
statement:
lemma sum_card_eq_sum_incidence :
    (targetsW u v all_black).card + (targetsN u v all_black).card +
    (targetsE u v all_black).card + (targetsS u v all_black).card
    = ∑ p ∈  all_black, incidence_count u v all_black p

name: u_parts_intersection_eq_u
statement:
lemma u_parts_intersection_eq_u
    (h_u_mono : ∀ a ∈ u, ∀ b ∈ u, px a < px b → py a < py b)
    (h_u_inj : ∀ a ∈ u, ∀ b ∈ u, px a = px b → a = b)
    : u_lower u ∩ u_upper u = u

name: v_parts_intersection_eq_v
statement:
lemma v_parts_intersection_eq_v
    (h_v_mono : ∀ a ∈ v, ∀ b ∈ v, px a < px b → py b < py a)

    : v_lower v ∩ v_upper v = v

name: inter_card_le_one
statement:
lemma inter_card_le_one
    (h_u_mono : ∀ a ∈ u, ∀ b ∈ u, px a < px b → py a < py b)
    (h_v_mono : ∀ a ∈ v, ∀ b ∈ v, px a < px b → py b < py a)
    (h_u_inj : ∀ a ∈ u, ∀ b ∈ u, px a = px b → a = b)
    : (u ∩ v).card ≤ 1

name: incidence_count_of_pivot
statement:
lemma incidence_count_of_pivot
    (pivot : Point n)
    (h_inter : u ∩ v = {pivot})
    (h_piv_in_all : pivot ∈ all_black)
    : incidence_count u v all_black pivot = 4

name: incidence_count_of_u_diff
statement:
lemma incidence_count_of_u_diff
    (p : Point n) (hp : p ∈ u) (hp_not_v : p ∉ v)
    (pivot : Point n) (h_inter : u ∩ v = {pivot})
    (hu_sub : u ⊆ all_black)
    (h_u_mono : ∀ a ∈ u, ∀ b ∈ u, px a < px b → py a < py b)
    (h_v_mono : ∀ a ∈ v, ∀ b ∈ v, px a < px b → py b < py a)
    (h_u_inj : ∀ a ∈ u, ∀ b ∈ u, px a = px b → a = b)
    (h_v_inj : ∀ a ∈ v, ∀ b ∈ v, px a = px b → a = b)
    : incidence_count u v all_black p = 2

name: incidence_count_of_v_diff
statement:
lemma incidence_count_of_v_diff
    (p : Point n) (hp : p ∈ v) (hp_not_u : p ∉ u)
    (pivot : Point n) (h_inter : u ∩ v = {pivot})
    (hv_sub : v ⊆ all_black)
    (h_u_mono : ∀ a ∈ u, ∀ b ∈ u, px a < px b → py a < py b)
    (h_v_mono : ∀ a ∈ v, ∀ b ∈ v, px a < px b → py b < py a)
    (h_u_inj : ∀ a ∈ u, ∀ b ∈ u, px a = px b → a = b)
    (h_v_inj : ∀ a ∈ v, ∀ b ∈ v, px a = px b → a = b)
    : incidence_count u v all_black p = 2

name: covering_of_maximal_u
statement:
lemma covering_of_maximal_u
    (p : Point n) (hp : p ∈ all_black) (hp_not_u : p ∉ u)
    (h_maximal : ∀ p ∈ all_black, p ∉ u →
        (∀ q ∈ u, px q < px p → py q < py p) →
        (∀ q ∈ u, px p < px q → py p < py q) →
        False)
    : p ∈ u_lower u ∨ p ∈ u_upper u

name: covering_of_maximal_v
statement:
lemma covering_of_maximal_v
    (p : Point n) (hp : p ∈ all_black) (hp_not_v : p ∉ v)
    (h_maximal : ∀ p ∈ all_black, p ∉ v →
        (∀ q ∈ v, px q < px p → py p < py q) →
        (∀ q ∈ v, px p < px q → py q < py p) →
        False)
    : p ∈ v_lower v ∨ p ∈ v_upper v

name: incidence_count_of_others
statement:
lemma incidence_count_of_others
    (p : Point n) (hp : p ∈ all_black) (hp_not_u : p ∉ u) (hp_not_v : p ∉ v)
    (h_u_mono : ∀ a ∈ u, ∀ b ∈ u, px a < px b → py a < py b)
    (h_v_mono : ∀ a ∈ v, ∀ b ∈ v, px a < px b → py b < py a)
    (h_u_inj : ∀ a ∈ u, ∀ b ∈ u, px a = px b → a = b)
    (h_v_inj : ∀ a ∈ v, ∀ b ∈ v, px a = px b → a = b)
    (h_u_max : ∀ p ∈ all_black, p ∉ u →
        (∀ q ∈ u, px q < px p → py q < py p) →
        (∀ q ∈ u, px p < px q → py p < py q) → False)
    (h_v_max : ∀ p ∈ all_black, p ∉ v →
        (∀ q ∈ v, px q < px p → py p < py q) →
        (∀ q ∈ v, px p < px q → py q < py p) → False)
    : incidence_count u v all_black p = 1

name: source_on_face_W
statement:
lemma source_on_face_W (m : Matilda n all_black) (bw : Point n)
    (hbw : bw ∈ all_black) (hbw_pos : 0 < py bw)
    (h_in : m.mem ⟨bw.1, bw.2 - 1⟩) :
    py bw = m.y_max + 1 ∧ m.x_min ≤ px bw ∧ px bw ≤ m.x_max

name: source_on_face_E
statement:
lemma source_on_face_E (m : Matilda n all_black) (be : Point n)
    (hbe : be ∈ all_black) (hbe_bound : py be < n - 1)
    (h_in : m.mem ⟨be.1, be.2 + 1⟩) :
    m.y_min = py be + 1 ∧ m.x_min ≤ px be ∧ px be ≤ m.x_max

name: source_on_face_N
statement:
lemma source_on_face_N (m : Matilda n all_black) (bn : Point n)
    (hbn : bn ∈ all_black) (hbn_pos : 0 < px bn)
    (h_in : m.mem ⟨bn.1 - 1, bn.2⟩) :
    px bn = m.x_max + 1 ∧ m.y_min ≤ py bn ∧ py bn ≤ m.y_max

name: source_on_face_S
statement:
lemma source_on_face_S (m : Matilda n all_black) (bs : Point n)
    (hbs : bs ∈ all_black) (hbs_bound : px bs < n - 1)
    (h_in : m.mem ⟨bs.1 + 1, bs.2⟩) :
    m.x_min = px bs + 1 ∧ m.y_min ≤ py bs ∧ py bs ≤ m.y_max

lemma matilda_eq_iff_bounds_eq (m1 m2 : Matilda n all_black) :

    m1.x_min = m2.x_min ∧ m1.x_max = m2.x_max ∧
    m1.y_min = m2.y_min ∧ m1.y_max = m2.y_max

name: matilda_covers_at_most_one_core
statement:
lemma matilda_covers_at_most_one_core {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    {all_black u v : Finset (Point n)}
    (h_uniq_x : ∀ p ∈ all_black, ∀ q ∈ all_black, px p = px q → p = q)
    (h_uniq_y : ∀ p ∈ all_black, ∀ q ∈ all_black, py p = py q → p = q)
    (h_u_mono : ∀ a ∈ u, ∀ b ∈ u, px a ≤ px b → py a ≤ py b)
    (h_v_mono : ∀ a ∈ v, ∀ b ∈ v, px a ≤ px b → py b ≤ py a)
    (_h_u_inj : ∀ a ∈ u, ∀ b ∈ u, py a = py b → a = b)
    (h_v_inj : ∀ a ∈ v, ∀ b ∈ v, py a = py b → a = b)
    (m : Matilda n all_black) (l1 l2 : Label n)
    (h_ne : l1 ≠ l2) (h_cov1 : m.mem (label_pos l1).2) (h_cov2 : m.mem (label_pos l2).2)
    (props1 : (l1.type = .W → l1.source ∈ targetsWin u v all_black) ∧
              (l1.type = .N → l1.source ∈ targetsNin u v all_black) ∧
              (l1.type = .E → l1.source ∈ targetsEin u v all_black) ∧
              (l1.type = .S → l1.source ∈ targetsSin u v all_black))
    (props2 : (l2.type = .W → l2.source ∈ targetsWin u v all_black) ∧
              (l2.type = .N → l2.source ∈ targetsNin u v all_black) ∧
              (l2.type = .E → l2.source ∈ targetsEin u v all_black) ∧
              (l2.type = .S → l2.source ∈ targetsSin u v all_black))
    (h_not_X1 : l1.type ≠ .X) (h_not_X2 : l2.type ≠ .X) : False

name: total_labels_eq_sum
statement:
theorem total_labels_eq_sum :
    (targetsW c.u c.v c.all_black).card + (targetsN c.u c.v c.all_black).card +
    (targetsE c.u c.v c.all_black).card + (targetsS c.u c.v c.all_black).card
    = n + c.a + c.b + 1

name: labels_total_intersection
statement:
theorem labels_total_intersection :
    (targetsWin c.u c.v c.all_black).card + (targetsNin c.u c.v c.all_black).card +
    (targetsEin c.u c.v c.all_black).card + (targetsSin c.u c.v c.all_black).card
    ≥ n + c.a + c.b - 3

   (h_unique_x : ∀ p ∈ all_black, ∀ q ∈ all_black, px p = px q → p = q)
   (h_unique_y : ∀ p ∈ all_black, ∀ q ∈ all_black, py p = py q → p = q) :
    ∃ (u v : Finset (Point n)),
      u ⊆ all_black ∧ v ⊆ all_black ∧
      n ≤ u.card * v.card ∧
      (∀ p ∈ u, ∀ q ∈ u, px p < px q → py p < py q) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ u, ∀ q ∈ u, px p = px q → p = q) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ all_black, p ∉ u →
        (∀ q ∈ u, px q < px p → py q < py p) →
        (∀ q ∈ u, px p < px q → py p < py q) → False) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ v, ∀ q ∈ v, px p < px q → py q < py p) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ v, ∀ q ∈ v, px p = px q → p = q) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ all_black, p ∉ v →
        (∀ q ∈ v, px q < px p → py p < py q) →
        (∀ q ∈ v, px p < px q → py q < py p) → False)

statement:
lemma extended_pigeonhole {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    {s : Finset α} {f: α → β} {s' : Finset β} (hf : ∀ n ∈ s, f n ∈ s')
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 * n + s'.card - 1 ≤ s.card)
    : ∃ t : Finset (Finset α), t.card = n
      ∧ (∀ t' : Finset α, t' ∈ t → t' ⊆ s)
      ∧ (∀ t' : Finset α, t' ∈ t → t'.card = 2)
      ∧ ((t : Set (Finset α)).PairwiseDisjoint id)
      ∧ (∀ t' : Finset α, t' ∈ t → ∃ p : β, ∀ n : α, n ∈ t' → f n = p)

name: double_pigeonhole

lemma double_pigeonhole {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {γ : Type w} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
    {s : Finset α} {f₁: α → β} {f₂: (Finset α) → γ} {s₁ : Finset β} {s₂ : Finset γ}
    (hf₁ : ∀ n ∈ s, f₁ n ∈ s₁) (hf₂ : ∀ s' ⊆ s, f₂ s' ∈ s₂)
    (hs: 2 * s₂.card + s₁.card + 1 ≤ s.card)
    : ∃ t₁ t₂ : (Finset α), t₁.card = 2 ∧ t₂.card = 2
      ∧ t₁ ⊆ s ∧ t₂ ⊆ s ∧ Disjoint t₁ t₂
      ∧ (∃ p : β, ∀ n : α, n ∈ t₁ → f₁ n = p)
      ∧ (∃ p : β, ∀ n : α, n ∈ t₂ → f₁ n = p)
      ∧ (f₂ t₁ = f₂ t₂)

      have _hdist := h.dist
      rw [h1, Nat.sub_self, Nat.add_zero] at _hdist

      omega⟩))

      have _hdist := h.dist
      have hne : ¬ cc.1.1.1 = cc.2.1.1 := fun hv ↦ h1 (Fin.ext hv)
      have h2 := cc.1.1.2
      have h3 := cc.2.1.2
      omega⟩))

name: rule_up
statement:
theorem rule_up {m : ℕ} (_hm : 2 ≤ m) (x y : Cell m)
    (hx : isTree m x = true) (hy : isTree m y = true)

    (hyk : keyFn m y < keyFn m x) :
    (x.2.1 + pOffset m) % 6 = 1 ∧ 1 ≤ x.1.1 ∨
      (x.2.1 + pOffset m) % 6 = 3 ∧ x.1.1 = 1 ∨
        (x.2.1 + pOffset m) % 6 = 4 ∧ 2 ≤ x.1.1

name: rule_left
statement:

    (hyk : keyFn m y < keyFn m x) :
    (x.2.1 + pOffset m) % 6 = 0 ∧ x.1.1 = 0 ∨
      (x.2.1 + pOffset m) % 6 = 3 ∧ x.1.1 = 0 ∨
        (x.2.1 + pOffset m) % 6 = 1 ∧ x.1.1 = 0 ∨
          (x.2.1 + pOffset m) % 6 = 2 ∨
            (x.2.1 + pOffset m) % 6 = 4 ∧ x.1.1 = 1 ∨
              (x.2.1 + pOffset m) % 6 = 5 ∧ 1 ≤ x.1.1

name: phase_geom
statement:
lemma phase_geom (a b H : Pt) (u w : Pt) (n s : ℝ)
    (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (huw : ⟪u, w⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (hspan : ∀ v : Pt, v = ⟪v, u⟫_ℝ • u + ⟪v, w⟫_ℝ • w)
    (hb : b = a - dist a b • u)
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hnd : 4 * dist a b ≤ n)
    (hs : n - 1 / n ≤ s) (hs' : s ≤ n)
    (hH : dist b H ≤ n) :
    Real.sqrt (dist a b ^ 2 + 1 / 2) ≤
      max (dist H (a + s • u + w)) (dist H (a + s • u - w))

name: qfun_eq_sum
statement:
lemma qfun_eq_sum {K : Type*} [Field K] (P : Polynomial K) (x y z : K) :
    Qfun P x y z = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P.natDegree + 1), P.coeff k *
      (x * x ^ k + y * y ^ k + z * z ^ k -
        x * y * z * ((x - y) ^ k + (y - z) ^ k + (z - x) ^ k))

name: phiPoly_eval

      (2 * x * y - 1) ^ (P.natDegree + 1) *
        Qfun P x y ((x + y) / (2 * x * y - 1))

    ∀ (e : Fin n ≃ ZMod n) (ps : List (ZMod n)), Legal e ps →
      (StateA e a b (fsucc a ha) →
        (evPairs e ps).count (a, b) ≤ (evPairs e ps).count (fsucc a ha, b) + 1 ∧
        (evPairs e ps).count (fsucc a ha, b) ≤ (evPairs e ps).count (a, b)) ∧
      (¬ StateA e a b (fsucc a ha) →
        (evPairs e ps).count (a, b) ≤ (evPairs e ps).count (fsucc a ha, b) ∧
        (evPairs e ps).count (fsucc a ha, b) ≤ (evPairs e ps).count (a, b) + 1)

lemma wythoff_unique (F A : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hFmono : ∀ p q, 0 < p → p < q → F p < F q)
    (hAmono : ∀ p q, 0 < p → p < q → A p < A q)
    (hFpos : ∀ k, 0 < k → 0 < F k)
    (hApos : ∀ k, 0 < k → 0 < A k)
    (coverF : ∀ m, 0 < m → (∃ k, 0 < k ∧ F k = m) ∨ (∃ k, 0 < k ∧ F k + k = m))
    (coverA : ∀ m, 0 < m → (∃ k, 0 < k ∧ A k = m) ∨ (∃ k, 0 < k ∧ A k + k = m))
    (disjF : ∀ p q, 0 < p → 0 < q → F p ≠ F q + q)

    ∀ n, 0 < n → F n = A n

name: blocks_semi_inj_helper
statement:
lemma blocks_semi_inj_helper {a b: List (List Coin)}
  (hab : a.map List.length = b.map List.length)
  (hab' : (a.head?.bind fun l' ↦ l'.head?) = (b.head?.bind fun l' ↦ l'.head?))
  (ha₁ : [] ∉ a) (hb₁ : [] ∉ b)
  (ha₂ : ∀ l ∈ a, List.IsChain (fun x y ↦ (x == y) = true) l)
  (hb₂ : ∀ l ∈ b, List.IsChain (fun x y ↦ (x == y) = true) l)
  (ha₃ : List.IsChain (fun x y ↦ ∃ (hx : x ≠ []) (hy : y ≠ []), (x.getLast hx == y.head hy) = false) a)
  (hb₃ : List.IsChain (fun x y ↦ ∃ (hx : x ≠ []) (hy : y ≠ []), (x.getLast hx == y.head hy) = false) b)
  : a = b

statement:

    (h2q : n < 2 * q) (h4p : n < 4 * p) (hpn : p ≤ n) (hqn : q ≤ n) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (j : ℤ) * (mulSeq {p, q} (cfun p q x y) j - 1)

        + (if 2 * p ≤ n then ((2 * p : ℕ) : ℤ) * (x - 1) else 0)

lemma isChain_append {α : Type*} {R' : α → α → Prop} : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List α),
    l₁.IsChain R' → l₂.IsChain R' →
    (∀ a ∈ l₁.getLast?, ∀ b ∈ l₂.head?, R' a b) → (l₁ ++ l₂).IsChain R'
  | [], l₂, _, h₂, _ => by simpa using h₂
  | [a], [], _, _, _ => by simp [List.IsChain.singleton]
  | [a], b :: t, _, h₂, h => .cons_cons (h a (by simp) b (by simp)) h₂
  | a :: b :: s, l₂, h₁, h₂, h =>
      .cons_cons (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp h₁).1
        (isChain_append (b :: s) l₂ (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp h₁).2 h₂ (by simpa using h))

    ∀ {l : List ℕ}, l.IsChain R → (∀ x ∈ l, 2 ≤ x) →
      (l.flatMap (fun d => powChain d q e)).IsChain R ∧
      ((l.flatMap (fun d => powChain d q e)).head? = l.head?) ∧

        (((p.nth k).swapped k).2 < k ∧ k < ((p.nth k).swapped k).1))) :

name: circleEmb_factor

lemma circleEmb_factor {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {m' : ℕ} [NeZero m'] {a₀ : ZMod m} {l : ℕ}
    [NeZero (m - l)] (hl : l ≤ m)
    (D₂ : Finset (ZMod (m - l))) (hD₂ : D₂ ≠ Finset.univ)
    (D : Finset (ZMod m)) (hD : D ≠ Finset.univ)
    (hDeq : D = arcSet a₀ l ∪ D₂.image (skipMap a₀ l))
    (φ : ZMod m' → ZMod m) (hφ : CircleEmb D hD φ) :
    ∃ φ' : ZMod m' → ZMod (m - l), (skipMap a₀ l ∘ φ') = φ ∧ CircleEmb D₂ hD₂ φ'

name: transport_arc
statement:
lemma transport_arc {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {a₀ : ZMod m} {l : ℕ} [NeZero (m - l)]
    (hl1 : 1 ≤ l) (hl : l ≤ m) {c : ZMod m} {l₁ : ℕ} (hl₁ : 1 ≤ l₁)
    (hdisj : Disjoint (arcSet a₀ l) (arcSet c l₁)) :
    ∃ v : ZMod (m - l), l₁ ≤ m - l ∧
      (arcSet v l₁).image (skipMap a₀ l) = arcSet c l₁ ∧
      (∀ w : ZMod m → ℝ, ∑ x ∈ arcSet c l₁, w x = ∑ y ∈ arcSet v l₁, w (skipMap a₀ l y))

name: surgeryMany

lemma surgeryMany {t : ℕ} :
    ∀ {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (ca : Fin t → ZMod m) (la : Fin t → ℕ)
    (_hla1 : ∀ s, 1 ≤ la s) (_hlam : ∀ s, la s ≤ m)
    (_hdij : ∀ s₁ s₂, s₁ ≠ s₂ → Disjoint (arcSet (ca s₁) (la s₁)) (arcSet (ca s₂) (la s₂)))
    (hD : (Finset.univ.biUnion fun s => arcSet (ca s) (la s)) ≠ Finset.univ),
    ∃ (m' : ℕ) (_ : NeZero m') (φ : ZMod m' → ZMod m),
      CircleEmb (Finset.univ.biUnion fun s => arcSet (ca s) (la s)) hD φ ∧
      m' = m - ∑ s, la s

name: mergeValues
statement:
lemma mergeValues {t : ℕ} :
    ∀ {m k : ℕ} [NeZero m] (P : CirclePartition m k) (_hk : 0 < k)
    (ca : Fin t → ZMod m) (la : Fin t → ℕ) (w : ZMod m → ℝ)
    (_hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (_hval : ∀ i, 1 ≤ ∑ x ∈ P.arcOf i, w x)
    (_hla1 : ∀ s, 1 ≤ la s) (_hlam : ∀ s, la s ≤ m)
    (_hdij : ∀ s₁ s₂, s₁ ≠ s₂ → Disjoint (arcSet (ca s₁) (la s₁)) (arcSet (ca s₂) (la s₂)))
    (_harcval : ∀ s, ∑ x ∈ arcSet (ca s) (la s), w x < 1)
    (_htk : t < k)
    {m' : ℕ} [NeZero m'] (φ : ZMod m' → ZMod m)
    {hD : (Finset.univ.biUnion fun s => arcSet (ca s) (la s)) ≠ Finset.univ}

    ∃ P' : CirclePartition m' (k - t), ∀ i, 1 ≤ ∑ x ∈ P'.arcOf i, (w ∘ φ) x

name: hall_deficiency
statement:
theorem hall_deficiency {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (r : Fin n → Fin n → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    (pip : Fin n) (hpip : ∀ j, r pip j) :
    ∃ (M T : Finset (Fin n)) (f : Fin n → Fin n),
      pip ∈ M ∧
      T.card = M.card ∧
      (∀ p ∈ M, f p ∈ T ∧ r p (f p)) ∧
      (∀ p₁ ∈ M, ∀ p₂ ∈ M, f p₁ = f p₂ → p₁ = p₂) ∧
      (∀ p, p ∉ M → ∀ j ∈ T, ¬ r p j)
